reference: The moment their arms collapsed, the whole kitchen burst into laughter.
sk: V okamihu, keď im ruky padli, celá kuchyňa vybuchla smiechom.
cz: Ve chvíli, kdy jim paže padly, celá kuchyň vybuchla smíchy.
acceptable: {The moment|As soon as|The instant|When} their arms {collapsed|gave way|gave out|dropped|fell}, the {whole|entire} kitchen burst {into laughter|out laughing}.
{The moment|As soon as|The instant|When} their arms {collapsed|gave way|gave out}, the {whole|entire} kitchen {exploded with laughter|erupted in laughter}.
The {whole|entire} kitchen burst {into laughter|out laughing} {the moment|as soon as|the instant|when} their arms {collapsed|gave way|gave out|dropped|fell}.
The {whole|entire} kitchen {exploded with laughter|erupted in laughter} {the moment|as soon as|the instant|when} their arms {collapsed|gave way|gave out}.

mistakes.text: The moment their arms collapsed, the whole kitchen was bursting {into laughter|out laughing}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Náhly, krátky dej v tom okamihu vyjadruje Past Simple: „burst“, nie „was bursting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Náhlý, krátký děj v tu chvíli vyjadřuje Past Simple: „burst“, ne „was bursting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A sudden, short action at that moment needs Past Simple: “burst”, not “was bursting”.

mistakes.text: The moment their arms collapsed, the whole kitchen bursted {into laughter|out laughing}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Burst“ je nepravidelné sloveso, v Past Simple zostáva „burst“, nie „bursted“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Burst“ je nepravidelné sloveso, v Past Simple zůstává „burst“, ne „bursted“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Burst” is irregular: its Past Simple is “burst”, not “bursted”.

mistakes.text: The moment their arms were collapsing, the whole kitchen burst {into laughter|out laughing}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Oba deje sú krátke a idú hneď po sebe, preto aj tu Past Simple: „collapsed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Oba děje jsou krátké a jdou hned po sobě, proto i tady Past Simple: „collapsed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Both actions are short and happen one right after the other, so use Past Simple here too: “collapsed”.

mistakes.text: The moment their arms collapsed, the whole kitchen burst {in|with|from} laughter.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Správne spojenie je „burst into laughter“ alebo „burst out laughing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Správné spojení je „burst into laughter“ nebo „burst out laughing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The fixed phrase is “burst into laughter” or “burst out laughing”.

mistakes.text: The moment their arms collapsed, whole kitchen burst {into laughter|out laughing}.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Whole” needs an article here: “the whole kitchen”.
